versions.content: Semantics of DiagnosticFunctionIdentifier A Diag- nosticFunctionIdentifier can be inhibited by different sources, i.e. in different ways: Event This corresponds to the DiagnosticEvent . Fim Event Group This represents a group of events that is defined in the scope of the Fim (within the Fim terminology, this is also known as a summary event ). In the meta-model, a Fim Event Group is represented by means of meta-class DiagnosticFimEventGroup . To emphasize the locality the corresponding meta-class has been named Diag- nosticFimEventGroup . DiagnosticFimEventGroup is able to reference 0..* DiagnosticEvent s in the role event . This way, the membership of DiagnosticEvent s in the hypothetical group of events formed by the DiagnosticFimEventGroup is expressed.
